title: Create the Horizon acquisition accretion model
prompt:
Create this file:
`Deliverables/Horizon acquisition accretion dilution model - 7.4.xlsx`

Begin with the July corporate-development investment-committee thread in `Requests/`, including the controller's banker-case warning. Work through the shared finance folders as an Alder Ridge analyst would: determine which controller-tied workpapers and operating extracts are current, use prior versions only for permitted comparison, and resolve conflicts from dates, approvals, document status, and the management correspondence. Reconcile any Alder Ridge posted baseline through the contractor-accounting MCP; external target, peer, bank, or market evidence remains controlled by the applicable finance source and must not be forced into Alder Ridge's ledger.

This is an independently reset assignment. Build the deliverable from the shared company sources and do not copy an output produced by another task.

Create `Buyer Standalone`, `Target Standalone`, `Sources & Uses`, `Purchase Accounting`, `Combined`, `Accretion Dilution`, and `Checks`. Model financing mix, incremental interest, the documented 4.2% foregone yield on cash consideration, amortization of identified intangibles, depreciation step-up, tax effects, phased cost synergies, share issuance, and one-time integration costs outside adjusted EPS. Calculate year-one and year-two GAAP and adjusted EPS accretion/dilution with sources-and-uses, balance, EPS, and source controls.

Document the controlling sources inside the deliverable. Recalculate or render as appropriate and save to the exact target path. The file is graded.
